title: fix(console): a refused form submit marks the fields it names; markdown placeholder in sans
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8BctHrSkyXGrwQzN3KmQW7Q)_
Fixes #27417

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:Console 表单页(公开 `/f/:slug`、`/forms/:name`、应用内表单)提交被拒时,逐个标出被拒字段(`aria-invalid` + 控件下方原因);markdown/html/richtext 编辑器的占位文字改用无衬线字体,输入的源码仍是等宽。
- 为什么改:HotCRM 18.2.0 浏览器走查(#27355 第 9、10 行):拒绝只给横幅和 toast,不指明哪个输入框;描述框占位文字是等宽字体。
- 风险与回滚:只改界面标记与一个 CSS 类,横幅与 toast 原样保留;回滚即还原本 PR 两个源文件。
- 先看:`ui/apps/console/src/components/FormPage.tsx`(`refusedWriteError` 与 catch 里的 `extractFieldErrors`)、`ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/RichTextField.tsx`、新测试 `FormPage.refusalMarks-27417.test.tsx`。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run apps/console/src/components/FormPage.refusalMarks-27417.test.tsx`,预期 8 个测试全绿。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- **Row 10, field marks (`@object-ui/console`, `FormPage.tsx`).** Every refusal on the form page used to end in one string on the banner and the outcome toast. Each refused row is now marked: `aria-invalid="true"` on its control and the reason under the control, which the control names in `aria-describedby`.
  - Client required check: each empty required row, with the record form's `validation.required` message ("Name is required").
  - Faulted `visibleWhen`: the row is marked and points at the banner, which already names the field and the rule, so no sentence is repeated under it.
  - Server refusals: the record dialog's reader of the server's field paths, `extractFieldErrors` from `@object-ui/react`, reads the refusal. No second parser was written. `submitPublic` / `submitInternal` used to throw a bare `Error(text)`, which lost the field paths. They now throw `refusedWriteError`, which keeps the same message and attaches the parsed body the way `@objectstack/client` attaches it (`code`, and `details` = wrapped `error.details`, else the flat body). That covers the flat `400 VALIDATION_FAILED` with `fields[]`, the wrapped dispatcher envelope, and the flat `409 UNIQUE_VIOLATION` naming its `field`. Only the rows the form draws are marked.
  - A refusal that names no field marks nothing. On a tabbed or wizard view the first marked row's tab or step opens, through one `revealRefused` shared by the client and server paths (the client path's existing behaviour, moved, not changed). Editing a marked row clears its mark. The banner and the toast are unchanged.
- **Row 9, placeholder font (`@object-ui/fields`, `RichTextField.tsx`).** The markdown / html / richtext textarea is `font-mono` on every host, and its placeholder inherited that. It now carries `placeholder:font-sans`, so typed source stays mono and the placeholder reads as prose. This widened the claimed file surface; the seat approved it in its thread.
- **Row 9, brand colour: no code change.** Measured below: the in-app route already takes the app's colour. The app-less routes know no app, and that half is an open question for the seat.
- Changeset: `@object-ui/console` patch, `@object-ui/fields` patch.

## Why

HotCRM's browser pass on 18.2.0 (#27355 rows 9 and 10): a refused public-form submit showed a toast and a banner but marked no field, and the form's description placeholder was monospace.

## Tests

- New `ui/apps/console/src/components/FormPage.refusalMarks-27417.test.tsx`, 8 tests. A server refusal naming A and B marks both and not the third row, on the public route (flat envelope) and the internal route (wrapped envelope). A 409 UNIQUE_VIOLATION marks its one field. An edit clears one mark and keeps the other. A 400 naming no field marks none. A field the form does not draw marks nothing. The client required refusal marks both empty required rows and writes nothing. A faulted `visibleWhen` row points at the banner.
- New `ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/__tests__/RichTextField.placeholderFont-27417.test.tsx`, 3 tests (markdown, html, richtext): the control keeps `font-mono` and carries `placeholder:font-sans`. jsdom computes no placeholder style, so the computed font is the Chromium reading below.
- Ablation (one-time, through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, fix committed first): row `mark` forced to `undefined` makes 6 of 8 red. The 2 that stay green are the "marks none" pins, as predicted. Restored blob matches `HEAD`.
- Regression at head d32c6b12: every `FormPage*.test` plus the fields RichText, aria-invalid and dom-leak suites, 47 files and 739 tests, all passed. `pnpm --filter @object-ui/console --filter @object-ui/fields run type-check` exit 0.

## Acceptance notes

- Seat 2's open PR #27305 also edits `FormPage.tsx`, in its `FORM_SPEC_TYPES` hunk only. That hunk is disjoint from these, and whichever lands second merges main.
- Row 9's app-less half is left open. `/forms/:name` renders in the app-independent Home layout, and the anonymous `GET /forms/:slug` payload is `slug, object, label, form, objectSchema`, with no app and no branding. The app metadata read is authenticated, so no server read was invented. It is reported to the seat as an open question with options.
- The placeholder takes Tailwind's `font-sans` stack, which is a system sans stack. The console body sets its own system stack, which differs in its first families. Both are sans.

## Verification

Real Chromium (`/opt/pw-browsers/chromium`) against the showcase backend (`objectstack dev --fresh`) and the console's Vite dev server. "Before" is `FormPage.tsx` at main and "after" is this branch.

| Reading | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| `/f/contact-us`, empty submit: Name / Email / Message `aria-invalid` | false / false / false | true / true / true, each described by "X is required"; Company false |
| `/f/contact-us`, server 400 `VALIDATION_FAILED` on `email` (real server answer) | no field marked | Email true, described by "Email must be a valid email address"; others false |
| Submit button vs `--primary`, `/apps/showcase_app/forms/showcase_inquiry.contact` | rgb(124, 59, 237) = app `#7C3AED` | unchanged |
| Submit button vs `--primary`, `/forms/...` and `/f/contact-us` | rgb(0, 123, 255), the default (no app known) | unchanged |
| Markdown row placeholder `font-family` | ui-monospace stack | -apple-system / system sans stack; control stays ui-monospace |
| Textarea and text rows placeholder | body sans | unchanged |

The server-refusal probe set `form.noValidate` before submitting, because the browser's own email check would otherwise stop the submit before the server judged it. The server's answer is its real one.

Derived gates at d32c6b12: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 34 families. All 34 exit 0, including `node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs` and the ui `scripts/` suite (169 files passed). `--ran` reconciliation: 34 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED. `pnpm --dir ui run check:new-line-citations`: 0 new citations.
